text:
Served items: 2 slices of toasted wholemeal bread (~70 kcal each, 140), 2 fried or poached eggs (~90 each, 180; they look cooked without much oil, so ~160), a latte-type coffee with milk (~80 kcal), water, and 2 butter portions (~7 g each, ~50 kcal each, 100).

Served total: 140 + 160 + 80 + 100 = 480 kcal.

Left over: one butter portion remains unopened (~50 kcal) and the coffee has a little left (~10 kcal), plus crumbs. The other butter tub is empty on the plate. Leftover is about 60 kcal.

Eaten: 480 − 60 = 420 kcal.

Macros eaten, summed over the items:
- Toast: about 24 g carbs, 6 g protein, 2 g fat per two slices... more precisely ~25 g carbs per slice-pair is too low, so I use about 26 g carbs, 7 g protein, 2 g fat per slice, giving 52 g carbs, 14 g protein, 4 g fat for both.
- Eggs: 12 g protein, 10 g fat, 1 g carbs.
- Milk coffee: 4 g protein, 4 g fat, 6 g carbs.
- Butter, one portion eaten: ~8 g fat.

Totals: protein ≈ 14 + 12 + 4 = 30 g, which is high for 420 kcal, so I reduce the toast to ~10 g protein total. That gives protein ≈ 26 g, carbs ≈ 40 g (toast ~34 g, milk ~6 g), and fat ≈ 10 + 4 + 8 + 3 = 25 g.
